spec.moment: Sitting under the skylight at home with a hot bowl of ramen while the rain drums overhead.

elements.name: skylight
elements.look: one tall square window set into a slanted roof, streaked with rain, glowing warm amber from inside

elements.name: ramen bowl
elements.look: a steaming ceramic bowl of noodles in golden broth with a soft-boiled egg and green onions, steam curling up

elements.name: cat latte
elements.look: a small cream-colored cup of latte with a cat face drawn in the foam, sitting on a wooden counter

elements.name: flipped umbrella
elements.look: a small blue umbrella turned inside out, spokes up, dripping onto wet pavement

elements.name: rainy street
elements.look: a wet city sidewalk with glossy puddles reflecting warm shop-window light

spec.scene: A wet city sidewalk patch at dusk, glossy puddles shining under warm shop-window light. A small blue umbrella lies flipped inside out at the front left, dripping. At the center a wooden counter holds a cream cup of latte with a cat drawn in the foam, a little larger than life. Behind it rises a slanted roof with one tall square skylight glowing amber, rain streaking the glass. Under the skylight sits a steaming bowl of ramen on a low table, a small figure in a rust sweater curled beside it.
spec.title: Ramen Under the Skylight
spec.caption: Rain on the skylight, ramen in my hands, a cat in my coffee. Good enough Monday.
